Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Intern position at Elevate Medical Spa South Tampa. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media integration, and short-form video editing, I am eager to bring my skills to your team and contribute to your medical aesthetics marketing efforts.

In my current role at Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, which has honed my attention to detail and ability to maintain brand voice. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented social media integration and structured data, demonstrating my ability to plan and execute content strategies. I am comfortable with video editing tools and familiar with TikTok and Instagram trends, and I am excited about the opportunity to film on-site and capture behind-the-scenes content that highlights your staff's personality.

I have attached my resume and content samples for your review. I would love to discuss how I can contribute to Elevate Medical Spa's social media presence.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
